case_metadata.title: Case 1: Cheadle A521 / Draycott Cross Rd Junction
case_metadata.subtitle: VL19 OKP (Blue Peugeot 2008 Rollover) vs GD64 LKU (VW Golf — Expired MOT)

agentic_video_scrub_steps.summary: Pass 1 (1x Macro Scene Scrub & Causal Relevance Filter): Identified Cheadle A521 / Draycott Cross Rd urban T-junction from elevated static Ring CCTV (FOV 110°). Stripped 3 non-causal background objects (2 distant parked domestic cars on Draycott Cross Rd and 1 non-involved roadside bin cluster) while retaining 2 causally involved vehicles (VL19 OKP & GD64 LKU) and 4 static regulatory/sightline features.

Pass 2 (High-FPS Temporal Crop t=0.40s..1.40s): Tracked Blue Peugeot 2008 (VL19 OKP) emerging Southbound across Diagram 1003 Give Way double dashed line at 18.6 mph without halting (braking_active=false). Tracked Silver/Grey VW Golf (GD64 LKU) approaching Eastbound on A521 at 41.2 mph in a 30 mph street-lit zone, initiating heavy braking at t=0.50s (nose pitch dive observed) and scrubbing velocity to 33.4 mph at impact (t=1.15s).

Pass 3 (Post-Impact Rollover & DVSA Causal Audit t=1.15s..3.00s): Verified offside B-pillar impact at (0.0m, 0.2m) deflecting VL19 OKP onto a 118° ESE heading and inducing an 86.0° nearside rollover. Cross-referenced live UK DVSA MOT History: flagged GD64 LKU's expired MOT (2026-05-02) and worn front/rear brake discs as CAUSAL to its extended wet stopping envelope, while flagging historical rectified MOT failures and surface suspension corrosion as NOT CAUSAL.

physics_audit_log:
ANTIGRAVITY SANDBOX KINEMATIC & ROLLOVER VERIFICATION (`antigravity-preview-09-2026` | `gemini-4-argon`):
1. STOPPING DISTANCE AT 30.0 MPH vs 41.2 MPH (DAMP TARMAC μ = 0.55):
   - Compliant 30.0 mph (13.41 m/s): Thinking distance (t_r = 0.67s) = 8.98m; Wet braking distance = v² / (2·g·μ) = 16.66m; Total forensic stopping distance = 25.64m.
   - Actual GD64 LKU Speed 41.2 mph (18.42 m/s) with DVSA worn front/rear brake discs (μ_eff = 0.51): Thinking distance = 12.34m; Wet braking distance = 33.91m; Total = 46.25m (+80.4% stopping envelope extension).
2. KINETIC ENERGY & ROLLOVER TORQUE VERIFICATION:
   - Pre-impact braking from t=0.50s to t=1.15s scrubbed GD64 LKU speed from 41.2 mph to 33.4 mph (14.93 m/s).
   - Lateral impact impulse delivered into VL19 OKP offside B-pillar at (0.0m, 0.2m): E_k = 0.5 × 1,385 kg × (14.93 m/s)² = 154.4 kJ.
   - Because the Peugeot 2008 SUV center of gravity (h_cg = 0.64m) sits above the VW Golf front bumper impact plane (h_imp = 0.46m), the overturning moment rotated roll_deg from 0.0° (t=1.00s) -> 28.0° (t=1.15s) -> 72.0° (t=1.50s) -> 86.0° nearside rest (t=2.00s..3.00s).

report.incident_summary: At approximately 14:22 BST on damp tarmacadam at the Cheadle A521 / Draycott Cross Road urban T-junction (30 mph limit), a 2019 Blue Peugeot 2008 SUV (VL19 OKP, Vehicle A) emerged Southbound from Draycott Cross Road across Diagram 1003 Give Way markings at 18.6 mph without halting. Concurrently, a 2015 Silver/Grey Volkswagen Golf (GD64 LKU, Vehicle B) approached Eastbound along the A521 priority corridor at 41.2 mph (37.3% above the 30 mph statutory limit) while operating with an EXPIRED UK DVSA MOT Certificate (expired 2 May 2026 at 93,028 miles) and unrectified DVSA advisories for worn/pitted front and offside-rear brake discs. Despite emergency braking onset at t=0.50s, GD64 LKU could only scrub speed to 33.4 mph before striking the offside B-pillar of VL19 OKP at (x=0.0m, z=0.2m) at t=1.15s, deflecting the Peugeot 2008 East-Southeast and rolling it onto its nearside (roll_deg = 86.0°).

report.stopping_distance_analysis: Under UK Highway Code Rule 126, at the lawful 30.0 mph speed limit (13.41 m/s) on damp tarmac (mu = 0.55), thinking distance (t_r = 0.67s) is 8.98m and wet braking distance is 16.66m, yielding a total stopping distance of 25.64m (meaning a compliant driver sighting VL19 OKP at 22.4m would have slowed to <6 mph or avoided contact entirely). At GD64 LKU's actual pre-braking speed of 41.2 mph (18.42 m/s), kinetic energy increased by +88.6%; compounded by DVSA-recorded worn/pitted front and offside-rear brake discs (effective mu_eff = 0.51), total stopping distance expanded to 46.25m (12.34m thinking + 33.91m braking), leaving GD64 LKU travelling at 29.5 mph at the point of impact.

forensic_events.description: At clip start (t = 0.00s), Vehicle A (VL19 OKP, Blue Peugeot 2008 SUV) is emerging Northbound (heading 1.9 deg, 19.8 mph) across the South Give Way line at (0.00m, +3.45m) while Vehicle B (GD64 LKU, Silver VW Golf) approaches Eastbound on the A521 priority carriageway at 41.2 mph (-9.66m, -0.95m).
Vehicle B (GD64 LKU) initiates emergency braking at (-6.10m, -0.95m, 38.4 mph, pitch -1.6 deg) as Vehicle A continues entering the crossroad box at (0.06m, +1.69m, 19.4 mph).

Primary T-bone collision inside the 4-way crossroad: Vehicle B's front bumper (-2.97m, -0.95m, 29.5 mph) strikes Vehicle A's nearside (left) front door and B-pillar at (0.12m, -0.05m, 18.6 mph), inducing immediate 6.0 deg starboard roll and northeastward lateral shove.
Lateral tire-scrub and high-CG overturning moment drive Vehicle A to 48.0 deg roll at (1.62m, -1.40m, 17.6 mph) as both vehicles deflect toward the Northeast corner verge.

Vehicle A (VL19 OKP) strikes and bends the Northeast corner telegraph pole / 30 mph speed sign at (3.8m, -3.6m), rolling onto its side at 86.0 deg roll (3.55m, -3.22m) and sliding to rest at (3.76m, -3.43m) while brown verge dust billows across the junction through t = 4.50s.

primary_highway_code_rules_breached: Highway Code Rule 172 & RTA 1988 s.36: VL19 OKP failed to give way at Diagram 1003 double broken white lines when emerging from Draycott Cross Rd onto the A521 priority road.
Highway Code Rule 170: VL19 OKP emerged into a restricted-sightline junction at 18.6 mph without creeping or ensuring a safe gap.
Highway Code Rule 124 & RTRA 1984 s.81: GD64 LKU exceeded the statutory 30 mph built-up area speed limit by travelling at 41.2 mph (+37.3%).
Highway Code Rule 125 & Rule 126: GD64 LKU drove too fast for damp tarmac conditions (mu = 0.55) with worn brake discs, expanding stopping distance from 25.6m to 46.3m.

Road Traffic Act 1988 s.47 & s.40A: GD64 LKU operated on a public highway with an EXPIRED MOT Certificate (expired 2026-05-02 at 93,028 miles) and unrectified DVSA multi-axle brake disc wear advisories.

case_law_citations.legal_principle: A driver emerging from a minor side road onto a priority road undertakes a hazardous operation and bears primary liability, subject to contributory negligence if the priority driver approached at excessive speed.
case_law_citations.application_to_crash: Fixes primary 75% liability on the emerging Blue Peugeot 2008 (VL19 OKP) for pulling across the Draycott Cross Rd Give Way line without yielding.

case_law_citations.application_to_crash: Imposes a 25% contributory negligence deduction against the A521 priority VW Golf (GD64 LKU) for approaching the Cheadle junction at 41.2 mph in a 30 mph limit.

report.legal_reasoning_chain:
1. PRIMARY BREACH (75% DEFENDANT — Vehicle A: Blue Peugeot 2008 (VL19 OKP), Defendant): Under Highway Code Rules 170 and 172 and Road Traffic Act 1988 s.36, the driver of Vehicle A owed an unambiguous statutory duty to give way at the Diagram 1003 double broken white lines on Draycott Cross Road. Because the northwest brick terrace and hedgerow limited west sightlines to 26.0m, Worsfold v Howe [1980] required Vehicle A to halt or creep at <4 mph. Emerging across the Give Way line at 18.6 mph with zero braking (braking_active=False) was the dominant proximate cause of the collision.
2. CONTRIBUTORY NEGLIGENCE & DVSA CAUSAL AUDIT (25% CLAIMANT — Vehicle B: Silver VW Golf (GD64 LKU), Claimant): Pursuant to Section 1(1) of the Law Reform (Contributory Negligence) Act 1945, Harding v Hinchcliffe [1964], and Froom v Butcher [1976], the driver of Vehicle B bears 25% contributory responsibility. Photogrammetric tracking proves Vehicle B approached at 41.2 mph in a street-lit 30 mph zone (+37.3% speed excess, +88.6% kinetic energy). Furthermore, live UK DVSA MOT History confirms Vehicle B's MOT EXPIRED on 2 May 2026 (93,028 miles, breaching s.47 RTA 1988) with CAUSAL unrectified advisories for worn, pitted, and scored front and offside-rear brake discs (1.1.14 (a) (i)), extending its wet stopping distance to 46.25m and triggering Policy #UK-8841 Section 4 Clause 4.2.

**Date:** 31 October 2026
**Our Claim Ref:** `UK-2026-0819` | **Incident Location:** A521 / Draycott Cross Road Junction, Cheadle, Staffordshire Moorlands
**Vehicles Involved:** Vehicle A: Blue Peugeot 2008 (VL19 OKP), Defendant & Vehicle B: Silver VW Golf (GD64 LKU), Claimant

Dear Sirs,

#### RE: PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENT CLAIMS — LIABILITY APPORTIONMENT (75% / 25%) & SUBROGATED DEMAND
